title: ygjson legality events
description: legality/bans.json: changes to a card's status in a format, sorted by card, format and date. A card's status in force on a date is its last event on or before it; before its first event it is legal.

status.description: Copies allowed: banned 0, limited 1, semi_limited 2, legal 3.

effective.description: The date the change took effect, when a source states it.

inForceBy.description: The date the tool first saw the status, for a status no source dates. The change may have started earlier.

source.description: Where the event comes from: a URL or a source name (ygojson, ygoprodeck).
